data.content_ref: inline:Augment the grounded extension so that every accepted conjecture carries a minimal set of committed root nodes that entail it, and define acceptance as membership in the maximal fixed point whose per-node provenance sets are all root-valid. This turns validity into a per-node, checkable certificate and strengthens the 'validity of every committed root' guarantee into a constructive provenance property. The criticism: computing minimal entailment sets is generally NP-hard, so the polynomial-cost guarantee is lost unless the provenance computation is restricted to a tractable fragment, and the maximal-fixed-point choice may violate the skeptical minimality that grounded semantics guarantees.
